events.verdict: Alvarado (NOP) reaches in and makes contact with Embiid's (PHI) arm, which affects his jump shot attempt.
Bey (NOP) brings his off-arm toward Edgecombe's (PHI) side and marginal contact occurs that does not affect Edgecombe's ability to defend during the drive.
Barlow (PHI) avoids making contact with Bey's (NOP) head as he maintains verticality and absorbs the contact that occurs during his shot attempt near the rim.
Oubre Jr. (PHI) is moving alongside Bey's (NOP) path with a collapsed forearm and marginal body contact occurs as they come together during the drive.
Barlow (PHI) maintains verticality as he defends Bey's (NOP) shot attempt.
Oubre Jr. (PHI) reaches in and initiates contact with Williamson's (NOP) arm during his drive and the contact affects his SQBR.

After Philadelphia secures the rebound at :19.1, Maxey (PHI) brings the ball up the sideline and request a timeout at :13.4. After the timeout, and communication with the table, possession was awarded to the Pelicans incorrectly on the grounds of an 8 second violation. Which did not occur.
Murphy III (NOP) commits a take foul on Embiid (PHI).
